e.title: Berne Union（伯尔尼联盟）：出口信用与投资保险的行业报告、年鉴与术语表
e.title_en: Berne Union: industry reports, a yearbook and a glossary for export credit and investment insurance
e.title_hk: Berne Union（伯爾尼聯盟）：出口信用與投資保險的行業報告、年鑑與術語表
e.summary: 出口信用与投资保险业的国际组织：发布 State of the Industry 年报、Berne Union Yearbook 与行业术语表，设成员名录、能力共享市场与气候小组等倡议，并与 ICISA 合编商业信心指数
e.summary_en: The international organisation for export credit and investment insurance: it publishes a State of the Industry report, the Berne Union Yearbook and a glossary of industry terms, runs a member directory plus initiatives such as a capacity-sharing marketplace and a climate group, and co-produces a business confidence index with ICISA
e.summary_hk: 出口信用與投資保險業的國際組織：發布 State of the Industry 年報、Berne Union Yearbook 與行業術語表，設成員名錄、能力共享市場與氣候小組等倡議，並與 ICISA 合編商業信心指數
e.body:
**Berne Union（伯尔尼联盟）** 是**出口信用与投资保险（export credit and investment insurance）业的国际组织**——**其成员主体是各国的官方出口信用机构（ECA）与政治风险/投资保险人**。本条目补的是**「政治风险与出口信用」这一形态**：**实测池内「政治风险」为 0**，**「信用与保证险」仅 1 条附带命中**——**即这一类主权/贸易信用风险此前完全空白**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200（约 54.1KB），标题实测 **「Berne Union - Berne Union home page」**；⭐ **「State of the Industry Report 2025」页实测 45.5KB，标题「Berne Union - State of the Industry Report 2025 Published」**；⭐ **成员名录页 `/Members` 实测 396.5KB，标题「Berne Union」**；**导航实测揭示的组织结构**（**为逐字读取所得，条目分类如下**）：**About (About the Berne Union / Member Directory / About Credit & Investment Insurance / Activities / Leadership / 90th Anniversary)**、**Media Resources**、**Industry News**、**Meetings & External Events**、**Initiatives（Stakeholders and partners / Official Correspondence / Capacity Sharing Marketplace / Climate Group / Young Professionals Initiative / Blended Finance Hackathon 2026）**、**Publications（Press Releases / Subscribe to the BUlletin / Glossary of Industry Terms / How Credit Insurance Supports the Real Economy / Berne Union Yearbook 2025 / State of the Industry 2025 / BU Publications & Research / Reading room）**，以及 **Prospective Members**、**Mailing List**、**Careers**、**Press kit**；实测另见与 **[[icisa]]** 相关的 **「Berne Union-ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2」** 文章条目，**并实测到页面所链接的 PDF 资源地址**（含 **Berne Union and ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2.pdf**、**Credit insurance and its role supporting world trade.pdf**、**How credit insurance supports the real economy.pdf**）；实测另有 **「From Climate Risk to Practical Decisions」网络研讨会** 与 **Yearbook 征稿通知（截止 2026-09-30）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「主权与贸易信用风险」这一整类**——**出口信用保险承保的是「外国买方不付款」与「东道国政治事件导致损失」**，**风险来源是国家而非个人或企业**；**对做主权风险、跨境信用与政治风险的学生，这是池内此前完全没有的一类**（可与同轮 [[icisa]] 的私营信用险并读——**一个官方、一个私营，覆盖同一风险的两端**）。**② ⭐ 「State of the Industry」+「Yearbook」构成年度连续披露**——**行业组织自己出年报与年鉴**，这是**获取该行业规模与趋势的第一手连续来源**；**注意：本次实测只确认了这两个出版物的存在与年份（2025），未打开内容**。**③ ⭐ 「能力共享市场（Capacity Sharing Marketplace）」与「混合金融黑客松 2026」是两个不常见于保险行业协会的倡议**——**前者指向再保险与能力的分摊机制、后者指向混合金融（blended finance，公共资金撬动私人资本）**；**对研究「公共—私人风险分担结构」的学生，这两条是具体的制度观察点**（可与 [[seadrif]] 的东南亚灾害风险保险基金、[[a2ii]] 的普惠保险监管倡议、[[microinsurance-network]] 并读——**三者都是「公共与私人共同承担风险」的不同形态**）。**④ 「Glossary of Industry Terms」与 [[icisa]] 的三套术语表形成呼应**——**两个协会各自维护本业术语表**（可与 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] 并读）。**⑤ ⭐ 「90th Anniversary」说明这是历史最久的保险业国际组织之一**（**成立约 1934 年**，**但本词条不据此断言具体成立年份——页面上只读到「90th Anniversary」这一栏目名**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、导航结构与出版物栏目名，以及所链接 PDF 的资源地址**，**但未打开 State of the Industry 正文、未打开 Yearbook、未打开术语表、未打开成员名录内容、未下载任何 PDF、未打开任何倡议页面**，因此**不能转述任何业务规模、赔付数据、成员名单或术语定义**；**② 「官方出口信用机构（ECA）与政治风险保险人为主体」的表述来自「About Credit & Investment Insurance」与「Member Directory」等栏目名的推断**，**本次未打开成员名录确认成员构成——故该表述在词条中作为机构性质说明，具体成员构成不作主张**；**③ 「90th Anniversary」仅核实为栏目名**，**具体成立年份未核实**；**④ 「Blended Finance Hackathon 2026」「Climate Group」等倡议的内容、参与方与成果本次未核实**；**⑤ 与 [[icisa]] 合编指数的编制方法、发布频率与本次未核实**（**仅核实两站均发布该指数及 PDF 资源地址**）；**⑥ 相关 PDF 位于 `bublob.blob.core.windows.net`，本次仅从页面 HTML 中读到其地址，未发起下载**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Berne Union 提供精算工具、定价模型或逐单数据。**核实说明**：首页（约 54.1KB，标题「Berne Union - Berne Union home page」）、`/Members`（396.5KB）、`/Articles/Details/1019/State-of-the-Industry-Report-2025-Published`（45.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航与栏目名；**未打开报告、年鉴、术语表、成员名录内容或任何 PDF**。
e.body_en:
**The Berne Union** is **the international organisation for the export credit and investment insurance industry** — **its members are chiefly national official export credit agencies (ECAs) and political-risk or investment insurers**. This entry adds the **"political risk and export credit"** form: **a measured count found zero for political risk and only one incidental hit for credit and surety insurance** — **this entire class of sovereign and trade credit risk was previously absent**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 (about **54.1KB**) with the measured title **"Berne Union - Berne Union home page"**; ⭐ the **"State of the Industry Report 2025" page measures 45.5KB with the title "Berne Union - State of the Industry Report 2025 Published"**; ⭐ the **member directory `/Members` measures 396.5KB with the title "Berne Union"**; **the navigation read verbatim reveals the following structure**: **About (About the Berne Union / Member Directory / About Credit & Investment Insurance / Activities / Leadership / 90th Anniversary)**, **Media Resources**, **Industry News**, **Meetings & External Events**, **Initiatives (Stakeholders and partners / Official Correspondence / Capacity Sharing Marketplace / Climate Group / Young Professionals Initiative / Blended Finance Hackathon 2026)**, **Publications (Press Releases / Subscribe to the BUlletin / Glossary of Industry Terms / How Credit Insurance Supports the Real Economy / Berne Union Yearbook 2025 / State of the Industry 2025 / BU Publications & Research / Reading room)**, plus **Prospective Members**, **Mailing List**, **Careers** and **Press kit**; there is also a measured article on the **"Berne Union-ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2"** relating to **[[icisa]]**, **with measured PDF asset URLs read from the page HTML** (including **Berne Union and ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2.pdf**, **Credit insurance and its role supporting world trade.pdf** and **How credit insurance supports the real economy.pdf**); there is also a measured **"From Climate Risk to Practical Decisions"** webinar and a **Yearbook call for papers (closing 30 September 2026)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the entire class of sovereign and trade credit risk** — **export credit insurance covers "a foreign buyer fails to pay" and "loss caused by political events in the host country"**, **so the source of risk is a state rather than an individual or firm**; **for students working on sovereign risk, cross-border credit and political risk this class was entirely absent** (readable with [[icisa]] in the same round — **one official, one private, covering two ends of the same risk**). **② ⭐ "State of the Industry" plus the "Yearbook" give continuous annual disclosure** — **a trade body publishing its own annual report and yearbook**, a **first-hand continuous source for the industry’s size and trends**; **note that this check confirmed only the existence and year (2025) of these publications, and opened neither**. **③ ⭐ The "Capacity Sharing Marketplace" and the "Blended Finance Hackathon 2026" are initiatives unusual for an insurance trade body** — **the former points at mechanisms for sharing reinsurance capacity, the latter at blended finance (public money mobilising private capital)**; **for students studying public-private risk-sharing structures these are concrete institutional observations** (readable with [[seadrif]], the Southeast Asia disaster risk insurance fund, [[a2ii]] and [[microinsurance-network]] — **three different forms of public and private risk sharing**). **④ The "Glossary of Industry Terms" echoes [[icisa]]’s three glossaries** — **each association maintains its own body of terminology** (readable with [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]). **⑤ ⭐ The "90th Anniversary" item indicates one of the oldest international insurance organisations** (**established around 1934**, **but this entry does not assert a founding year — only the "90th Anniversary" navigation label was read**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, navigation structure and publication labels, plus the PDF asset URLs read from the HTML**, **but opened no State of the Industry body, no Yearbook, no glossary, no member directory content, downloaded no PDF and opened no initiative page**, so **no business volume, claims data, member list or terminology definition can be restated**; **② the statement that official export credit agencies and political-risk insurers dominate membership is inferred from navigation labels such as "About Credit & Investment Insurance" and "Member Directory"**, and **the member directory was not opened to confirm composition — so that wording stands as a description of the organisation’s nature, with no claim about specific membership**; **③ "90th Anniversary" was verified only as a label**, and **the founding year was not verified**; **④ the content, participants and outcomes of initiatives such as the "Blended Finance Hackathon 2026" and the "Climate Group" were not verified**; **⑤ the joint index’s methodology and publication frequency were not verified** (**only that both sites publish it, and the PDF asset URLs**); **⑥ the PDFs sit on `bublob.blob.core.windows.net`, and their addresses were only read from the page HTML — no download was initiated**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the Berne Union provides actuarial tools, pricing models or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (about 54.1KB, title "Berne Union - Berne Union home page"), `/Members` (396.5KB) and `/Articles/Details/1019/State-of-the-Industry-Report-2025-Published` (45.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation and labels read verbatim; **no report, yearbook, glossary, member content or PDF was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**Berne Union（伯爾尼聯盟）** 是**出口信用與投資保險業的國際組織**——**其成員主體是各國官方出口信用機構（ECA）與政治風險／投資保險人**。本條目補的是**「政治風險與出口信用」這一形態**：**實測池內「政治風險」為 0**，**「信用與保證險」僅 1 條附帶命中**——**即這一類主權／貿易信用風險此前完全空白**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁約 **54.1KB**，標題實測 **「Berne Union - Berne Union home page」**；⭐ **「State of the Industry Report 2025」頁 45.5KB**；⭐ **成員名錄 `/Members` 396.5KB**；**導航逐字實測揭示結構**：**About（About the Berne Union / Member Directory / About Credit & Investment Insurance / Leadership / 90th Anniversary）**、**Initiatives（Capacity Sharing Marketplace / Climate Group / Young Professionals Initiative / Blended Finance Hackathon 2026）**、**Publications（Press Releases / Subscribe to the BUlletin / Glossary of Industry Terms / How Credit Insurance Supports the Real Economy / Berne Union Yearbook 2025 / State of the Industry 2025 / BU Publications & Research / Reading room）**；實測另見與 **[[icisa]]** 相關的 **「Berne Union-ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2」** 文章，**並從頁面 HTML 讀到所鏈接的 PDF 資源地址**；另有 **「From Climate Risk to Practical Decisions」** 網絡研討會與 **Yearbook 徵稿通知（截止 2026-09-30）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「主權與貿易信用風險」這一整類**——**出口信用保險承保「外國買方不付款」與「東道國政治事件導致損失」**，**風險來源是國家而非個人或企業**（可與同輪 [[icisa]] 的私營信用險並讀——**一個官方、一個私營**）。**② ⭐ 「State of the Industry」+「Yearbook」構成年度連續披露**（**本次僅確認其存在與年份 2025，未打開內容**）。**③ ⭐ 「能力共享市場」與「混合金融黑客松 2026」是不常見於保險行業協會的倡議**——**前者指向再保險與能力分攤、後者指向混合金融**；**對研究「公共—私人風險分擔結構」的學生是具體制度觀察點**（可與 [[seadrif]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 並讀）。**④ 「Glossary of Industry Terms」與 [[icisa]] 的三套術語表形成呼應**。**⑤ ⭐ 「90th Anniversary」說明這是歷史最久的保險業國際組織之一**（**但本詞條不據此斷言具體成立年份**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、導航結構與出版物欄目名、以及所鏈接 PDF 的資源地址**，**但未打開 State of the Industry 正文、未打開 Yearbook、未打開術語表、未打開成員名錄內容、未下載任何 PDF、未打開任何倡議頁**，故**不能轉述任何業務規模、賠付數據、成員名單或術語定義**；**② 「官方出口信用機構與政治風險保險人為主體」係由欄目名推斷**，**未打開成員名錄確認——故僅作機構性質說明，具體成員構成不作主張**；**③ 「90th Anniversary」僅核實為欄目名**，**具體成立年份未核實**；**④ 相關倡議的內容、參與方與成果未核實**；**⑤ 合編指數的編制方法與發布頻率未核實**；**⑥ 相關 PDF 位於 `bublob.blob.core.windows.net`，本次僅從 HTML 讀到地址、未發起下載**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Berne Union 提供精算工具、定價模型或逐單數據**。**核實說明**：首頁、`/Members`、State of the Industry 頁均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航與欄目名；**未打開報告、年鑑、術語表、成員名錄內容或任何 PDF**。
